name: authnudge
description: Log an agent into a website by approving on your phone. Connect your Authnudge account with OAuth, or set a handle and API key. Fills Chrome with remote debugging. Usernames and passwords never appear in chat.

AUTHNUDGE_TO.title: Authnudge email or handle
AUTHNUDGE_TO.description: Optional fallback when the Authnudge OAuth connection is not used. If set, the fallback login uses this handle and the agent must not ask for one.

AUTHNUDGE_API_KEY.title: API key
AUTHNUDGE_API_KEY.description: Optional fallback when the Authnudge OAuth connection is not used. Dashboard API key (an_…). If set, the agent must not ask you to paste a public key. If omitted too, the agent shows its public key and you paste it under Access → Public keys.
